subject: general
question: The market structure called monopoly exists where there __________ in any market.

options.text: is a stiff competition between top brands

solution:
The correct solution is __**exactly one seller.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **The market structure called monopoly exists where there is exactly one seller in any market.**
 
• Monopoly:
 
 
• A monopoly exists in areas where one company, firm, or entity is the **only - or dominant - seller that sells a product or service in an industry.**
 
• This gives the **seller enough power to keep other competitors away from the marketplace.**
 
• A government can create a monopoly by nationalizing a product or service such as the postal service.
 
• Due to the lack of competition a firm can charge a set price above what would be charged in a competitive market, thereby maximizing its revenue.
 
• The best example of a monopoly in the Indian market is** Indian Railways.​**
